<a id="page-components"></a>
# Components

Calling a component, and writing one: its head (`component`, `param`, `event`, `slot`, `preview` lines) and its
tree. Open it when a UI reuses a part, or you write a component for a site or a design system.

<a id="components-calling-one"></a>
## Calling one

A component is written like any word: `Name "text" key=value bind=name onEvent={…}`. Its strings fill its text
parameters in order; `bind=` is where it keeps its value; its events are `on…` keys by their own names.

<a id="components-writing-one"></a>
## Writing one

A component's document is its head, then its tree (no canvas):

```notation
component StatusPill "A short status, colored by its tone."
  param label="Active" required doc="What it says."
  param tone:neutral|success|danger="neutral"
  event onChanged:String doc="The new label."
  slot trailing
  preview "Default" 120x28 label="Active" tone="success"
Row#pill gap=4
  Text#pillLabel "Active"
```

- `param name[:Type]=default`: a parameter, its type in Flutter's names (`String`, `bool`, `double`, `int`,
  `List<…>`, `ValueNotifier<…>` for a variable parameter, an enum's values joined by `|`) where the default does
  not say it; `required` and `doc="…"` after it.
- `event name:Type`: an event and the type of its payload.
- `slot name`: a place the caller fills with lines.
- `preview "Name" 340x66 key=value …`: a preview, its size and the call's values.

A word defined in the text (`define`, [design-systems.md](design-systems.md)) is written out where it is used: it
is not a component of the document.

<a id="components-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-slot"></a>
### `Slot` (`slot`)

Inside a component: where the call's children (or one named slot) go; its own children show when the call passes none.

- Written `Slot`. Level 3 (Design systems).
- Takes no quoted string.
- The lines under it are its children.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `"children"` | 3 | children (the call's children) or a declared slot name. |

<a id="node-external"></a>
### `External` (`external`)

A widget built by the app.

- Written `External`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `builderId` | text | `""` | 4 | The id of the app's builder. |

<a id="node-placeholder"></a>
### `Placeholder` (`placeholder`)

An empty slot (`SizedBox`).

- Written `Placeholder`. Level 0 (Core).
- `Placeholder "…"` sets `props.text`.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `""` | 0 |  |
| `leadingAsset` | text | `""` | 0 |  |

<a id="node-singlePlaceholder"></a>
### `SinglePlaceholder` (`singlePlaceholder`)

A one-child slot.

- Written `SinglePlaceholder`. Level 0 (Core).
- Takes no quoted string.
- The lines under it are its children.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allowedTypes` | list of text | `[]` | 0 | The node types the slot accepts (empty: any) and refuses. |
| `deniedTypes` | list of text | `[]` | 0 |  |
| `maxAllowedSize` | [Size](values.md#type-Size) |  | 0 | The largest child it accepts, `[width, height]`. |
| `ephemeral` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Its child is temporary (not kept when the slot is filled again). |

<a id="components-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onEvent`](events.md#trigger-event).
- Actions: [`componentEvent`](events.md#action-componentEvent).

## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="components-example-site-components-header-json"></a>
### site/components/Header.json

From [`site/components/Header.json`](../components.md).

```notation
component Header "The site's top bar: the name (home) and an About link (a modal)."
  param savedCount:int=0
Row#bar gap=16 pad=[20,0,20,0] w={"fill":390} h=56 fill=paper border-bottom=line {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null}}
  Text#brand "Waymark" w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} style={"from":"body","fontWeight":700} onTap={go home}
  Text#count "{props.savedCount} saved" right w={"fill":120} h={"hug":22} style={"from":"body","color":"muted"}
  Text#about "About" w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} style=link onTap={openModal to=about presentation=dialog}
```

### site/pages/home.json

From [`site/pages/home.json`](../components.md).

```notation components
canvas "Home" path="/" h=844 fill=paper
Column#page scroll w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844} {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null}}
  Header#header w={"fill":390} h=56 {"type":"Header","bind":{"props.savedCount":"${= length(saved)}"},"props":null}
  Column#main gap=16 pad=20 w={"fill":390} h={"hug":300} maxWidth=960
    Text#title "Trips by rail" w={"fill":350} h={"hug":34} style=title
    ListView#tripList w={"fill":350} h={"hug":200} scrollable=false gap=12 {"bind":{"data":"${trips}"}}
      Row#tripCard between pad=[16,0,16,0] w={"fill":350} h=64 fill=#FFFFFFFF border=line radius=12 onTap={navigate to=trip params={"id":"${item.id}"}} {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null}}
        Text#tripName "{item.name}" w={"hug":200} h={"hug":22} style={"from":"body","fontWeight":600}
        Text#tripDays "{item.days} days" w={"hug":60} h={"hug":22} style={"from":"body","color":"muted"}
  Footer#footer w={"fill":390} h=64 {"type":"Footer","props":null}
Canvas#about "About" w=320 h=180 decoration.radius=16
  Column#aboutBody gap=16 pad=24 w={"fill":320} h={"fill":180}
    Text#aboutText "Itineraries for travelling slowly by train." w={"fill":272} h={"hug":44} style=body
    Button#aboutClose "Close" w=120 h=40 onTap={close}
document {"nodes":{"home":{"actions":[{"trigger":{"type":"load"},"actions":[{"type":"setVariable","variable":"saved","value":"${= coalesce(storage.saved, [])}"}]}]}}}
```

### site/pages/trip.json

```notation components
state trip:map={coalesce(find(trips, 'id', route.id), first(trips))}
state isSaved:boolean={contains(saved, trip.id)}
canvas "Trip" path="/trip" h=844 fill=paper
Column#page scroll w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844} {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null}}
  Header#header w={"fill":390} h=56 {"type":"Header","bind":{"props.savedCount":"${= length(saved)}"},"props":null}
  Column#main gap=16 pad=20 w={"fill":390} h={"hug":400} maxWidth=960
    Text#back "Back" w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} style=link onTap={navigate mode=pop}
    Text#title "{trip.name}" w={"fill":350} h={"hug":34} style=title
    Button.outline#save "Save trip" w=160 h=40 onTap={if condition={"left":"${isSaved}","op":"isTrue"} then={setVariable variable=saved op=remove value={trip.id}} else={setVariable variable=saved op=add value={trip.id}}; setStorage key=saved valueType=list value={saved}; toast "{isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Removed'}"} {"bind":{"props.label":"${= isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Save trip'}"}}
    Text#packTitle "Packing list" w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} style={"from":"body","fontWeight":700}
    ListView#packList w={"fill":350} h={"hug":120} scrollable=false gap=8 {"bind":{"data":"${trip.packing}"}}
      Row#packRow gap=12 w={"fill":350} h=32 onTap={contains(coalesce(get(storage.packed, route.id), []), item) ? setStorage key="packed.{route.id}" valueType=list op=remove value={item} : setStorage key="packed.{route.id}" valueType=list op=add value={item}} {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null}}
        box#packBox w=20 h=20 fill=#FFFFFFFF border=accent strokeWidth=2 radius=4 {"bind":{"decoration.fills[0].color":"${= contains(coalesce(get(storage.packed, route.id), []), item) ? '#FF2F6B4F' : '#FFFFFFFF'}"}}
        Text#packName "{item}" w={"hug":200} h={"hug":22} style=body
  Footer#footer w={"fill":390} h=64 {"type":"Footer","props":null}
```

### components.md: schema, id

From [components.md](../components.md) (the block at line 13 of its template, pages/components.md).

```notation
component Chip "A label with a remove button." children=list
  param label="Chip" required
  param selected:ValueNotifier<bool>=""
  event onRemove:String
  slot leading
  preview "Selected" 240x48 label="Design" selected=true
state hovered=false
Row#chip gap=6 pad=[12,0,8,0] w={"hug":120} h=36 fill=#FFE8EAF6 radius=18 onTap={setVariable variable=props.selected op=toggle} {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null},"bind":{"decoration.fills[0].color":"${= props.selected ? '#FF3F51B5' : '#FFE8EAF6'}"}}
  Slot#lead name=leading {"layout":null}
  Text#text "{props.label}" size=14 color=#FF1A237E w={"hug":60} h={"hug":20} {"bind":{"props.style.color":"${= props.selected ? '#FFFFFFFF' : '#FF1A237E'}"}}
  Slot#extra {"layout":null}
  Icon#remove "close" w=20 h=20 color=#FF5C6BC0 onTap={emit onRemove props.label}
```

<a id="components-example-site-site-json"></a>
### site/site.json

From [`site/site.json`](../components.md). It is a site's manifest (`site.json`), not a page. It is written as JSON:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "pages": [
    "pages/home.json",
    "pages/trip.json"
  ],
  "components": [
    "components/Header.json",
    "components/Footer.json"
  ],
  "theme": {
    "colors": {
      "ink": "#FF1B1B1B",
      "paper": "#FFFAF7F2",
      "accent": "#FF2F6B4F",
      "muted": "#FF6B7280",
      "line": "#FFE5E1D8"
    },
    "textStyles": {
      "body": {
        "fontSize": 15,
        "height": 1.4,
        "color": "ink"
      },
      "title": {
        "from": "body",
        "fontSize": 28,
        "fontWeight": 700,
        "height": 1.2
      },
      "link": {
        "from": "body",
        "fontWeight": 600,
        "color": "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  "variables": [
    {
      "name": "trips",
      "type": "list",
      "value": [
        {
          "id": "alps",
          "name": "The Alpine Arc",
          "days": 7,
          "packing": [
            "Rail pass",
            "Rain shell",
            "Walking boots"
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "coast",
          "name": "Coast to Coast",
          "days": 5,
          "packing": [
            "Swimwear",
            "Sun hat"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saved",
      "type": "list",
      "value": []
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="components-example-components-md-nodes"></a>
### components.md: nodes

From [components.md](../components.md) (the block at line 43 of its template, pages/components.md). It is a map of values, not a document. It is written as JSON:

```json
"nodes": {
  "design": {"type": "Chip", "props": {"label": "Design", "selected": "tag"},
             "slots": {"leading": "dot"}, "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": 36},
             "actions": [{"trigger": {"type": "event", "event": "onRemove"},
                          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "removed", "value": "${result}"}]}]},
  "dot": {"type": "box", "layout": {"width": 8, "height": 8}, "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FF4CAF50"}], "radius": 4}},
  "tags": {"type": "listView", "children": ["tagChip"], "bind": {"data": "${tags}"},
           "props": {"scrollDirection": "horizontal", "spacing": 8}, "layout": {"width": {"fill": 360}, "height": 36}},
  "tagChip": {"type": "Chip", "bind": {"props.label": "${item.name}"}, "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"fill": 36}}}
}
```
